ValidationRule.description: Account Owner change should be enabled only for Accounts without SAP Code. If SAP Code present, change should be request via Service team. The team is changing Owner in SAP and synced to Salesforce is automatically performed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" && $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Sales_Operation_Manager" && $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Sales_Operations_Specialist" && $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "EMEA_Business_Team" && NOT( ISBLANK( SAP_Code__c ) ) && ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) && (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Account_NACA" || RecordType.DeveloperName = "Account_EMEA")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In order to change Account Owner synchronized with SAP, please confirm it with your Sales Director first.
